name: Presents of Mind
title: Azrael: Agent of the Bat #61
desc:
Christmas in No Man's Land finds the Joker taking instead of giving! When Batman learns that the Joker has kidnapped babies from all over Gotham in an effort to "murder hope," it falls to Azrael and Batgirl to save them.

Batman called Azrael and Batgirl to search Lex Luthor's camp for the Gotham babies that had been kidnapped by the Joker. Meanwhile, Azrael and Batgirl shared a moment together as they both learned about their similar lives & the meaning of Christmas. At the camp Azrael saved Batgirl and Mercy from an explosion, but suffered major burn damage.
